text:
nora: RFC follow-up: concise operator playbook for shifting a customer from shared-peering -> per-tenant ephemeral relay. constraints: preserve src IP if allowed, avoid exhausting lease pool during spikes, provide a single-command fast rollback. want exact ops cmds we can paste into the runbook.

diego: +1. keep it minimal and reversible. add preflight that surfaces SNAT policy, active long sessions, and current lease pool usage.

sai: Proposed minimal steps:
1) preflight check
2) reserve small lease pool in target region
3) create relay + cert verify + warm probes
4) shadow 2-5% traffic for 10m
5) promote with sticky leases (configurable ttl)
6) monitor metrics then reclaim old leases
All steps reversible.

sai: example commands (ops-friendly):
```bash
# preflight: snat, sessions, lease usage
opsctl customer preflight --customer=cust-420 --fields=snat,active_sessions,lease_usage --ticket=INC-2026-4200
# reserve 20 leases
curl -s -X POST https://ops.internal/egress/v1/leases -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" -d '{"customer":"cust-420","count":20,"region":"us-west-2"}'
# create relay + wait cert
opsctl relay create --name=rel-usw2-21 --region=us-west-2 --customer=cust-420 --ticket=INC-2026-4200
opsctl relay cert-wait --relay=rel-usw2-21 --timeout=120
opsctl relay probe --relay=rel-usw2-21 --shots=100
# shadow 3% traffic
opsctl route modify --customer=cust-420 --target=rel-usw2-21 --sample=3 --ticket=INC-2026-4200
# promote when stable (sticky ttl default 600s)
opsctl route promote --customer=cust-420 --target=rel-usw2-21 --sticky-ttl=600 --ticket=INC-2026-4200
```

mira: monitoring & autoscale rules: watch egress.lease_pool_available, relay.health, cp.request_latency. If lease_pool_available < 12% -> reduce sample to 0-1%, trigger controller autoscale, and prefer evicting non-sticky short-TTL leases first.

diego: rollback (1-command fast path):
```bash
opsctl route rollback --customer=cust-420 --to=shared-peering --ticket=INC-2026-4200
```

diego: if exhaustion ongoing -> also run:
```bash
kubectl -n infra scale deployment/egress-operator --replicas=$(($(kubectl get deploy egress-operator -o jsonpath='{.status.availableReplicas}')+2))
# optionally add more reserved leases
curl -s -X POST https://ops.internal/egress/v1/leases -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" -d '{"customer":"cust-420","count":30,"region":"us-west-2"}'
```

ops-bot: ALERT: lease_pool_available for cust-420 at 11% (threshold 12%). INCIDENT INC-2026-4200 created and assigned.

mira: small note on sticky-ttl: use 1800s for websocket-ish customers and enable relay->operator lease-refresh: `curl -X POST https://ops.internal/egress/v1/leases/refresh -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RELAY_TOKEN' -d '{"lease_id":"<id>","extend_seconds":1800}'`

nora: good. action items: sai -> add preflight output to opsctl; diego -> add autoscale hook; mira -> document sticky-ttl guidelines. I'll add these commands to the RFC reply. keep replies short.
